head: 4b382e5388e652308d2beca448666630ba6c332d
summary: The change replaces misleading JSON errors and preserves HTTP status internally, but the intended command output still discards that status. Its maintenance cost is small; the diagnostic outcome remains incomplete.
reasons: The two-file change matches the planned scope, reuses Error.from_gh, and adds no dependencies or configuration. One reported review round shows no approach-level churn.
The desired outcome is user-visible diagnosis. Preserving http_status on an exception does not achieve that when callers publish only its message.
Incident frequency and measured attention savings are unknown. Instruction-growth evidence is absent, but no instruction files changed.
concerns: skills/shaka/lib/shaka/status.rb publishes only e.message as requiredChecksUnavailable. Because required_checks retains its generic message, pr, pr watch, and handoff still cannot expose the rate-limit status.
skills/shaka/scripts/shaka.rb prints only e.message for merge failures. The retained HTTP status therefore does not reach the maintainer through this path either.
alternative: Keep the narrow lookup fix and existing HTTP parser. Surface the parsed status through a sanitized required-check diagnostic or structured evidence consumed by these commands. Preserve raw-stderr exclusion and existing no-checks handling; neither guarantee needs to be lost.
next_action: Revise this PR so a simulated HTTP 403 reaches command output, and verify that behavior at the caller boundary.
